events.input: $ for c in e0c046f 2ba0273 8c94364; do echo "== $c"; git branch -a --contains $c 2>/dev/null | head -5; git show --stat --format='%h %ad %s' --date=iso $c | head -25; done; git status -sb | head -20; git log origin/main --oneline -3; python3 - <<'E'

events.input: $ date; grep -c . workshop-plan/tasks/inbox.jsonl; grep 'F-184b482c' workshop-plan/tasks/inbox.jsonl | cut -c1-600; K=$(cat ~/.config/tantra/revops-admin-key); B=https://revops-centre.growthcluborg.workers.dev; grep -n "admin/api/zoom\|admin/api/calendar\|x-admin\|Authorization\|adminKey" cloud/src/index.ts | head -20
